name: Universal Product Code supermarket scanning
description: Machine-readable product code read at a supermarket checkout as part of a sale.

date.basis: Date stated by the cited source; see event scope.

events.statement: At a Marsh supermarket in Troy, Ohio, a cashier scanned a UPC-coded package purchased for 67 cents.

evidence.supports: GS1 names cashier and buyer, dates the scan and reports the gum price.

events.caveats: A retrospective report of one sale, not proof all barcode use began then.
